relationships.subject: ZI GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, these findings from both naïve and Vgat-Cre mice indicate that activation of ZI GABAergic neurons alleviates mechanical and thermal nociceptive hypersensitivity in the 6-OHDA-induced mouse model of PD.

relationships.subject: ZI GABA-VTA circuit
relationships.evidence_quote: Chemogenetic and optogenetic activation of the ZI<sup>GABA</sup>-VTA circuit alleviated pain symptoms; conversely, inhibiting activity within this circuit exacerbated both mechanical and thermal pain hypersensitivity.

relationships.subject: 6-OHDA
relationships.evidence_quote: Together, these results suggest that unilateral lesion of the striatum by 6-OHDA leads to a loss of dopaminergic neuron in the SNc, motor dysfunction as well as hypersensitivity to mechanical and thermal stimuli.

key_findings: Chemogenetic/optogenetic activation of ZI GABAergic neurons raises mechanical and thermal thresholds in naive and 6-OHDA PD mice; inhibition induces hypersensitivity.
The ZI GABA to VTA projection regulates PD-associated pain.
